1º de Primaria · Inglés

Clothes and weather

Ficha para imprimir
123456
1

Pregunta de arranquePiensa 30 segundos antes de seguir

Look out of the window. Is it sunny or rainy today? What clothes are you wearing?

Escribe o di en voz alta tu respuesta. Después .

If it's sunny, we wear a T-shirt. If it's rainy, we wear a coat and take an umbrella. In this unit you will learn clothes and weather words.

2

Aprende12 apartados

Para empezar: Teddy's suitcase

Ella is going to visit her grandma in the mountains. She takes her teddy bear, Teddy.

«What clothes do we need?» asks Ella. Mum looks at the weather on TV. «It's cold and snowy in the mountains.»

Ella puts a coat, a hat and boots in the suitcase. She puts a little scarf for Teddy too.

In the mountains, it is snowing. Ella and Teddy are warm.

«Thank you, Mum!» says Ella. «Now let's make a snowman!»

1. My clothes

We wear clothes every day.

This is a T-shirt. These are trousers. These are shoes.

Clothes keep us warm and clean. What are you wearing today?

Vídeo: This Is The Way We Get Dressed · Super Simple Songs (YouTube) · 2073,7 millones de visualizaciones

2. Skirt, dress and socks

More clothes: a skirt, a dress and socks.

Anybody can wear any clothes. Wear what you like and what is comfortable.

Socks go on our feet, inside our shoes. One sock, two socks!

3. Coat, hat and scarf

When it is cold, we wear a coat, a hat and a scarf.

We can also wear gloves on our hands and boots on our feet.

Brrr! Winter clothes keep us warm.

4. I'm wearing…

To say what clothes we have on, we say I'm wearing…

I'm wearing a red T-shirt. I'm wearing blue trousers.

Remember: the colour goes before the clothes. Look at your clothes and say what you are wearing!

5. The weather

The weather changes every day.

Today it can be sunny, cloudy or rainy.

To ask, we say: What's the weather like? We answer: It's sunny!

Vídeo: How's The Weather? · Super Simple Songs (YouTube) · 131,3 millones de visualizaciones

6. Windy and snowy

More weather words: windy and snowy.

When it's windy, the trees move and kites fly high.

When it's snowy, everything is white. We can make a snowman! And with a storm, there is thunder.

7. Hot and cold

In summer it is hot. In winter it is cold.

When it's hot, we say I'm hot! and drink water.

When it's cold, we say I'm cold! and put on a coat. How do you feel today?

8. Clothes for the weather

We choose clothes for the weather.

It's sunny: I wear a T-shirt, shorts and a cap.

It's rainy: I wear a raincoat and boots, and I take an umbrella. It's cold: I wear a coat, a hat and a scarf.

Vídeo: Get Dressed for the Day Song · The Singing Walrus (YouTube) · 9,6 millones de visualizaciones

9. The seasons

There are four seasons: spring, summer, autumn and winter.

In spring there are flowers. In summer it's hot. In autumn the leaves fall. In winter it's cold.

What's your favourite season?

10. Put on, take off

When we get dressed, we put on our clothes. Put on your coat!

When it's hot, we take off our jumper. Take off your hat!

Can you put on your shoes by yourself? Great!

11. Game: dress the bear

Play dress the bear. Draw a big bear on paper.

Roll a dice. Look at the weather card: sunny, rainy or snowy.

Choose clothes for your bear and say: It's rainy. The bear is wearing a raincoat and boots!

12. Review: clothes and weather

Now you know clothes: T-shirt, trousers, skirt, dress, shoes, coat and hat.

You know the weather: sunny, cloudy, rainy, windy and snowy.

You can say I'm wearing… and What's the weather like? Brilliant!

Lo hacemos juntos · Let's do it together

Look at the sky: there is a big sun. What's the weather like?

  1. There is a sun.
  2. Start with: It's…

Resultado: It's sunny.

Say what you are wearing.

  1. Look at your clothes.
  2. Start with: I'm wearing…
  3. Add colour and clothes.

Resultado: I'm wearing a green T-shirt.

It's rainy. What do you take?

  1. Rain makes us wet.
  2. We need something over our head.

Resultado: An umbrella.

It's snowy. Choose clothes.

  1. Snow is very cold.
  2. We need warm clothes.

Resultado: A coat, a hat and a scarf.

Errores típicos

  • Saying «a trousers»: trousers is always plural: «blue trousers».
  • Saying «It's sun»: we say «It's sunny».
  • Putting the colour after the clothes: «a red T-shirt», not «a T-shirt red».
  • Confusing «I'm cold» with «It's cold»: I'm cold is how you feel; it's cold is the weather.

PracticaResponde sin mirar arriba. Equivocarse aquí también enseña.

Ejercicios (22)

Hazlos en tu cuaderno y después abre la solución.

Nivel básico

  1. Point to your shoes and say: shoes.

    Ver solución
    Shoes.

  2. Draw a T-shirt and colour it.

    Ver solución
    A T-shirt in any colour.

  3. Draw a sun and write: sunny.

    Ver solución
    A sun and the word «sunny».

  4. Draw a cloud with rain and write: rainy.

    Ver solución
    A cloud with drops and the word «rainy».

  5. Match: abrigo – coat, gorro – hat.

    Ver solución
    Coat = abrigo; hat = gorro.

  6. Is it hot or cold in winter?

    Ver solución
    Cold.

  7. Put on your coat! (mime)

    Ver solución
    The child mimes putting on a coat.

  8. Say three clothes in English.

    Ver solución
    For example, T-shirt, trousers, shoes.

Nivel medio

  1. Complete: I'm wearing a ____ T-shirt.

    Ver solución
    Free answer, for example: blue.

  2. Answer: What's the weather like today?

    Ver solución
    It's sunny / cloudy / rainy… (free answer).

  3. It's rainy. What do you need?

    Ver solución
    An umbrella, a raincoat and boots.

  4. Write two clothes for a hot day.

    Ver solución
    T-shirt, shorts (or cap, dress).

  5. Write two clothes for a cold day.

    Ver solución
    Coat, hat (or scarf, gloves, boots).

  6. Complete: In winter it's ____. In summer it's ____.

    Ver solución
    cold; hot.

  7. Order the seasons: winter, spring, autumn, summer.

    Ver solución
    Spring, summer, autumn, winter.

  8. Describe a friend's clothes: He's / She's wearing…

    Ver solución
    Free answer.

  9. Make a weather chart for one week with drawings.

    Ver solución
    Free answer: one drawing each day.

Nivel avanzado

  1. Play «dress the bear» with weather cards.

    Ver solución
    Free answer, for example: It's snowy. The bear is wearing a coat.

  2. Pack a suitcase for the beach: write five things.

    Ver solución
    For example: T-shirt, shorts, cap, swimsuit, sun cream.

  3. Pack a suitcase for the mountains in winter: write five things.

    Ver solución
    For example: coat, hat, scarf, gloves, boots.

  4. Be a weather presenter: «Good morning! Today it's…».

    Ver solución
    Free answer.

  5. Describe your favourite season and the clothes you wear.

    Ver solución
    Free answer, for example: My favourite season is summer. I wear a T-shirt.
4

Explícalo con tus palabrasComo si se lo contaras a alguien de un curso menor

¿Has nombrado estas ideas?
★

Situación de aprendizajeThe weather report

Every morning this week, one child is the class weather presenter and says the weather and the right clothes in English.

Pasos

  1. We make a weather board with cards: sunny, cloudy, rainy, windy, snowy.
  2. The presenter looks out of the window and chooses a card.
  3. The presenter says: «Good morning! Today it's rainy. Wear a raincoat and boots!».
  4. The class checks: Is the presenter right?

Producto final: A weather board and a short weather report in English.

Cómo se valora

  • Names the weather in English.
  • Chooses clothes that fit the weather.
  • Speaks clearly to the class.

Resumen visualTodo el tema en una pantalla

Glosario

Clothes
Things we wear, like T-shirts and shoes (ropa).
T-shirt
A top with short sleeves (camiseta).
Trousers
Clothes for your legs (pantalones).
Coat
A warm thing to wear outside (abrigo).
Hat
A thing to wear on your head (gorro, sombrero).
Weather
How the sky and the air are today (tiempo).
Sunny
With a lot of sun (soleado).
Rainy
With rain (lluvioso).
Snowy
With snow (nevado).
Umbrella
A thing to stop the rain (paraguas).
6

Tarjetas de repasoToca la tarjeta para darle la vuelta

Según cómo respondas, la tarjeta vuelve mañana, en 3, en 7 o en 21 días.

Para familias

  • Cada mañana, preguntad «What's the weather like?» antes de vestiros.
  • Al vestirle, nombrad la ropa en inglés: T-shirt, trousers, socks.
  • Haced juntos la maleta de un viaje imaginario según el tiempo.
  • Cantad las canciones del tiempo y de vestirse del tema.

Para profesores

Saberes: Lengua extranjera (Inglés): léxico de la ropa, el tiempo atmosférico y las estaciones; estructuras I'm wearing…, What's the weather like? It's…; relación entre tiempo y ropa adecuada (RD 157/2022, primer ciclo de Educación Primaria).

  • Rutina diaria del tiempo con presentador o presentadora.
  • Juego de vestir un oso según tarjetas del tiempo.
  • Desfile de moda en inglés (I'm wearing…).
  • Relación con Ciencias Sociales: el tiempo y las estaciones.

Fuentes y revisión

  • Real Decreto 157/2022, enseñanzas mínimas de la Educación Primaria (BOE)

Revisado el 14 de noviembre de 2026.

Qué vas a aprender

  • Name clothes: T-shirt, trousers, skirt, dress, shoes, coat, hat
  • Say what I'm wearing: I'm wearing a…
  • Name the weather: sunny, rainy, cloudy, windy, snowy
  • Ask and answer What's the weather like?
  • Choose the right clothes for the weather

Palabras clave

clothes · T-shirt · trousers · shoes · coat · hat · weather · sunny · rainy · cold · hot

Tiempo

50 minutos hoy + 2 minutos en cada repaso
